explanationMd: Adding the same real number preserves order, so subtracting 7 does too. Squaring and reciprocation need extra sign conditions; negation reverses order.

distractorRationale.a: Assumes squaring preserves order across all real numbers.
distractorRationale.d: Ignores the case of opposite signs.
distractorRationale.b: Fails to reverse order on negation.
